title: free standing towel bar
text: free standing towel bar. I ultimately donated this because it was WAY too large for my counter.. but that is my bad for not looking at measurements.  If you have a giant counter - this might work for you - but... the "arms" take a HUGE amount of space that I wasn't planning on.  It looks nice.  Was easy to assemble and is weighty - sturdy.  I even tried to think of some other place/way to use it!  It's just too big for my use.  Very pretty, brushed stainless look.
